newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seen up on new accounts day.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seen up on new accounts day.

text.p: Pakistan stocks are likely to rise further on Wednesday amid new accounts buying ahead of Friday's budget for fiscal 1997/98, dealers said.
"Speculation ahead of the budget will continue to prompt retail buying," a dealer at a foreign brokerage house said.
On Tuesday, the Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 33.81 points, or 2.15 percent, to end at 1,605.93. Gainers led losers 142 to 132.
